captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric spool holder designed to sit on a flat surface. It consists of a low-profile, pinwheel-shaped base with four arms extending outwards. Each of the four outer corners features an upright support block designed to hold a bearing. These support blocks contain horizontal cylindrical channels for mounting hardware, with slots cutout to accommodate the bearings on which a filament spool can roll.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, low-profile spool holder base with four arms arranged in a pinwheel layout. The script should allow customization of spool dimensions (width, wall thickness, and outer diameter) as well as hardware dimensions (bearing diameter, bearing thickness, and bolt size) to dynamically position four slotted upright bearing mounts.
captions.factory: The design uses a 'holder' module that constructs the base and upright mounts. The base is formed from a central cube, which is then subtracted with a central cylinder and four rotated offset cylinders to create the pinwheel shape. Four uprights are positioned symmetrically using translate and rotate operations, each built by unioning a support cube and a rotated cylinder. Finally, a difference operation subtracts bolt-hole cylinders and inner bearing slots from each of the four uprights.
